faq.q: What boats are available for a sunset photoshoot yacht session in Marbella?
faq.a: For a 2-hour session, we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge are available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: How much does a sunset photoshoot yacht session cost in Marbella?
faq.a: The 2-hour sunset photoshoot session on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 costs €749. This includes skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges — just show up with your camera.

faq.q: What time does the sunset photoshoot session start?
faq.a: Departure times vary by season. From May to September, golden hour typically falls between 19:00 and 21:00. We recommend a 19:00 departure to catch the best light. In spring and autumn, sessions start around 18:00. We’ll confirm the exact time when you book.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer for the yacht session?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. You’re welcome to bring your own photographer. The boat capacity includes them — up to 9 guests on the Astondoa 40 or 11 on the Azimut 39. We can also recommend local photographers if needed; just ask via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Is the sunset photoshoot session suitable for couples or proposals?
faq.a: Yes, it’s perfect for couples, engagements, or surprise proposals. The private setting, golden light, and gentle cruise along the Marbella coastline create a romantic backdrop. We can arrange champagne or flowers on request.

faq.q: What is included in the sunset photoshoot yacht session?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and a selection of drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, cava, white wine) plus light snacks. Spanish IVA (21%) is already included in the €749 price. No hidden costs.

faq.q: Can I extend the sunset session to a longer charter?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade to a 4-hour or 8-hour charter. For example, the same boats cost €2,299 for 8 hours. Longer charters allow you to visit Cabopino, Estepona, or even Sotogrande. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom durations and pricing.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day of the session?
faq.a: If weather conditions are unsafe or the sunset is completely obscured, we’ll reschedule your session at no extra cost. We monitor forecasts closely and will advise you 24 hours ahead. Your safety and the quality of your photos are our priority.

data.body_html:
Capture the Costa del Sol at its most photogenic during a two-hour sunset photoshoot yacht session in Marbella 2038. Departing from Puerto Banús aboard a sleek Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you’ll cruise the coastline as the sun sinks behind La Concha mountain. The package costs €749 for up to 9 guests (Astondoa 40) or 11 guests (Azimut 39) — all-inclusive with skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and Spanish IVA. No hidden fees, no upselling. Just golden light, chilled cava, and a private yacht as your studio.

Why a sunset photoshoot yacht session in Marbella?

Marbella’s southern exposure means the sun sets directly over the Mediterranean, casting warm tones on white hulls and the Sierra Blanca peaks. A private yacht gives you unobstructed 360-degree views, zero crowds, and the freedom to choose your backdrop — from the luxury yachts of Puerto Banús to the rugged cliffs of Cala Cortés. Professional photographers love the consistent light between 19:00 and 21:00 from May to September. For influencers, couples, or brand shoots, this is the most efficient way to get high-quality content in a single session.

Which yachts are available for your sunset shoot?

We offer two ideal vessels for the 2-hour sunset session:

  • Astondoa 40 — 12.5 metres, up to 9 guests, €749/2h. Open-plan layout with ample deck space for group shots.
  • Azimut 39 — 12.5 metres, up to 11 guests, €749/2h. Sleek Italian design with a spacious flybridge for elevated angles.

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, cava, white wine), and light snacks. For larger groups or different aesthetics, ask about our full fleet via WhatsApp — including the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) for longer charters.

What’s included in the €749 package?

Everything is covered — no surprises. Your 2-hour session includes:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire cruise
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, first aid)
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — already included in the price

You bring your camera, phone, or hire a local photographer. We can also arrange flowers, champagne, or a personalised playlist on request.

Best spots for sunset photos along the Marbella coast

Your skipper will tailor the route based on wind and light, but typical highlights include:

  • Puerto Banús entrance — iconic with superyachts and the Andalusia skyline.
  • Cala del Faro — a quiet cove with rock formations that catch warm light.
  • Marbella Marina — the old port with traditional fishing boats contrasts with modern yachts.
  • Río Verde coastline — golden cliffs and pine forests frame the horizon.
  • La Concha mountain — visible from the sea, especially striking at sunset.

If you book a longer charter (4h or 8h), you can extend to Cabopino or Estepona for even more variety.

How to book your sunset photoshoot yacht session

Reservations are simple. Choose your preferred date and time (we recommend 19:00 May–September, 18:00 in spring/autumn). Contact us via WhatsApp for availability — we respond within hours. Payment is secure via bank transfer or card. Once confirmed, we’ll send you a boarding location at Puerto Banús and the skipper’s details. Browse all yacht experiences or message us directly to customise your session.
